proof.Root_player_index_binding: Root+C0 exactly aliases classifier Frame13 player_index_u32. Actual native damage context is carried across calls, including all RNG/event/module words. Frame12 words are not altered by these supplied providers.
proof.scope: Original F575/F577/F578 invokes whole original F953/F34/F35/F144/F148/F1530/F1538 and resumes after each measured reply. Exact pair/body/caller/global outputs and sequential shared context are compared. External handlers/event/audio/equipment/fatal callbacks remain typed authored replies; this is not a full world, Main or Android build.

buffer_codec: sha256-keyed zlib_base64; decoded byte_count and SHA256 must match
